name: handoff-validator
description: Machine-check the claims in a project's status document against git, so a line that was true when written cannot quietly become a lie.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Installs a validator that checks every falsifiable claim in your handoff or status document against git and the filesystem, plus git hooks that re-check after each commit and merge, and a /handoff command rendered for your repository. Catches dead commit references, false merge claims, stale 'not yet merged' statements, dead file pointers, and committed secrets. Configuration is derived by inspecting your repo rather than copied.
